description: This class defines the ModuleFilterMapping which models the association between a web filter and the servlets or URL patterns it applies to in the OpenMRS module system. It includes methods for managing filter mappings, checking pattern matches, and parsing filter configurations from XML.

classes.name: ModuleFilterMapping
classes.description: Represents the mapping of a web filter to specific servlets and URL patterns within a module, including methods to evaluate matches and parse configuration XML.

methods.name: filterMappingPasses
methods.description: Determines if a filter mapping passes for a given request path based on URL pattern or servlet name matches.

methods.name: retrieveFilterMappings
methods.description: Parses module configuration XML to extract a list of filter mappings defined in the module.
